en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to see any underwater
escape tricks for a while...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to see any underwater
escape tricks for a while...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably used for the
saw-a-person-in-half trick.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is going to be used for a magic
trick too. I've seen it in a magic show...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are several swords stabbed into
a human-sized box.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if there was a person inside, they
would come out just fine. That's the trick, I think.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a big cage...
I might fit inside this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know it's just for a magic trick,
but it still kind of creeps me out...
